name: Bitter/Sweet

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Countermass
perks.desc:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Quick Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's barrel provides faster projectiles and much faster aiming.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Smart Drift Control
perks.desc:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed

perks.name: Proximity Grenades
perks.desc: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

perks.name: Spike Grenades
perks.desc:
Grenades fired from this weapon do increased damage on direct hits.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Alloy Casing
perks.desc:
Reduces weight for faster reloads.
  •  Greatly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases stability

perks.name: Augmented Drum
perks.desc:
Heavy, high capacity drum.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed

perks.name: High-Explosive Ordnance
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are larger and travel faster.
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases magazine size

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Mini Frags
perks.desc:
Grenades are smaller and more compact for easier reloading.
  •  Increases magazine size
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Sticky Grenades
perks.desc: Grenades fired from this weapon attach on impact and detonate when enemies are in proximity.

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Disorienting Grenades
perks.desc:
Detonation has a brief disorienting effect. 
  •  Greatly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Reverberation
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for a short duration.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Loose Change
perks.desc: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for a short duration.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.desc:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.desc: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.

perks.name: Explosive Light
perks.desc: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.desc: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Dark Ether Reaper
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon periodically spawn Dark Ether charges.

Charges can be detonated early with weapons fire or by coming into contact with them. Doing so refills this weapon from reserves.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Envious Arsenal is the new hotness and Bitter/Sweet is one such hotness to get. Any of your favorite damage perks in the fourth column paired with Envious Arsenal is an easy damage rotation. It works best with Bait and Switch as both have similar activation requirements but Explosive Light is fantastic and Cascade Point has better burst DPS." Recommended MW: Blast Radius.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "For grenade launchers to be competitive in the crucible you need to hit or surpass 70 blast radius to kill all resilience levels. Volatile Launch and High-Explosive Ordinance both hit that with some room to spare. If you don't get that far you'd need to invest into a blast radius MW. Otherwise you can go velocity to make up for the lack of Impulse Amplifier. Unrelenting is great for going on sprees but if you're just running and gunning you should opt for Explosive Light to get even more damage per shot (i.e. forgiveness)." Recommended MW: Blast Radius or Velocity.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 119 from 22 October 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6CEZXurwhqejVZpX506M2a?si=7ef44c5f06ae4412) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways, and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MajorSpec PvE-BossSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for sustained Boss damage in both general and end-game, underleveled content. Bitter/Sweet is an arc adaptive grenade launcher with decent stats. At base, it has 39 Handling which equates to 0.44s ready, 0.43s ADS speed and 0.40s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 42 is a 3.22s reload. Total ammo at base with 0, 1, 2 and 3 reserve mods is 25/27/28/29. For an excellent boss damage roll, boost the Velocity and Handling with the barrel perk, and add Spike Grenades for its ×1.027 damage boost on direct impacts in the magazine. If you lean into the origin trait, this could result in an overflowed magazine of 10 (13 when the weapon is enhanced!). The new-for-season-25 Envious Arsenal in the first trait perk column procs on the same condition as Bait and Switch, so a full weapon damage rotation will reload the base magazine from reserves and provide a further ×1.3 damage boost for 10s. If you can proc the excellent Dark Ether origin trait before DPS starts, you can overflow the magazine by ×1.4 (rounded up) base capacity or ×1.8 when enhanced. Recommended MW: Handling or Velocity, with a Backup Mag mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 119 from 22 October 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6CEZXurwhqejVZpX506M2a?si=7ef44c5f06ae4412) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways, and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-MajorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing beefier Minor and Major enemies in both general and end-game, underleveled content. Bitter/Sweet is an arc adaptive grenade launcher with decent stats. At base, it has 39 Handling which equates to 0.44s ready, 0.43s ADS speed and 0.40s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 42 is a 3.22s reload. Total ammo at base with 0, 1, 2 and 3 reserve mods is 25/27/28/29. For a fun, completely unserious roll, boost the Velocity and Handling with the barrel, add Spike Grenades for its ×1.027 damage boost on direct impacts in the magazine, and play to proc the origin trait to overflow the magazine to 12 (15 when the weapon's enhanced). Then use Reverberation to maximise Blast Radius to help proc Killing Tally's ×1.3 boost to damage for the rest of the magazine until you stow or reload. The Dark Ether origin trait is one of the best in the sandbox for PvE - generate a Dark Ether charge for 5s from kills, and then shoot with any weapon (or run into) the charge to proc a Dragonfly-type detonation which also overflows your weapon to ×1.4 (rounded up) base capacity or ×1.8 when enhanced, completely bypassing reload. Recommended MW: Handling or Velocity, with a Backup Mag mod.
